description: Defines an abstract class HTMLPurifier_ChildDef that manages allowed child nodes and validation logic for HTML element children within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef
classes.description: Abstract class providing mechanisms for defining and validating child node rules for HTML elements in the purification process.

methods.name: getAllowedElements
methods.description: Returns the list of elements this definition considers permissible as children.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Abstract method to validate child nodes against the definition, returning either the same, modified, or removed nodes.
